# Bloo

Bloo is the little sky-blue unicorn who goes from sulking beside the yellow filly Noi to happily riding on Pinkie Pie during the Smile Song. She is a background character in the official G4 *Friendship is Magic* television continuity.

[![Hasbro Studios — Bloo (right) and Noi](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/2021/2/18/2310616/medium.png)](https://twibooru.org/2310616)

- **Appearance:** Cyan coat, pale lavender-blue swept mane and tail, magenta eyes, small horn and blank flank.
- **Name:** Bloo is a fandom name documented at least as early as 2015 in [Noinalysis](https://www.fimfiction.net/group/207085/noi/thread/167380/noinalysis). The screencap post above also records the fan alias Linky Dee. Neither is verified as an official name; the original naming event is unknown.
- **Appearances and voice:** Her confirmed appearance is *A Friend in Deed* (S2E18, February 18, 2012). No individual dialogue or voice actor, additional episode, film or comic appearance was verified.

## Important moments

Both moments belong to the same musical sequence in [A Friend in Deed (S2E18)](https://tv.apple.com/us/episode/a-friend-in-deed/umc.cmc.71fxehcv7o34w88m8z2hc6luk?showId=umc.cmc.3ujevsytv3nqn8uolyrrgws8j); exact video timestamps could not be verified.

- **Two unhappy fillies:** Bloo and Noi sit dejectedly together, giving Pinkie an opportunity to put her philosophy of cheering up others into practice.
- **Sliding into a smile:** Pinkie carries the pair down the stairs, and Bloo's delighted expression illustrates the success of Pinkie's kindness.

[![Hasbro Studios — Pinkie, Bloo and Noi on the stairs](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/2026/2/15/3711836/medium.png)](https://twibooru.org/3711836)
